direction: Hong Kong bakery: their white bilingual 美味屋 logo on bakery red, custard cream, egg-tart yolk, chunky Bagel Fat One type, vertical 美味屋 watermark
fonts: Bagel Fat One, Onest, Noto Serif TC
hero_idea: Their own 4-step custom cake process as a live builder in the hero: pick filling, sponge flavor and frosting from their real menu and the layered cake recolors; step 4 calls the shop
scroll_story: A glass of Hong Kong milk tea in the corner fills as you scroll down the page; pinned reviews section swaps each Instagram review with its pastry photo
custom_ui: Bakery-case shelves of their full menu as paper labels; neon OPEN/CLOSED sign from their store hours; 1998 count-up
